hero.title: Alongside those who decide.
hero.subtitle: Thirty years of experience in law, mediation and working with people at the top.

manifest.title: Manifesto
manifest.body: My work is guided by a fundamental conviction — without working with people, with their mindsets, values, relationships and aspirations, no solution — operational, structural or legal — holds in the long run. Behind every situation that calls for resolution stand people and their needs — whether it is an individual, an executive team, a dispute between partners, or a family in generational transition. I have deep experience with this dimension and know how to work with it deliberately. And through that, to truly help.

individual.title: One-on-One Partnership
individual.subtitle: For owners, top management and leading professionals
individual.description: I help articulate the questions you may already be asking yourself in pivotal moments — about your company, role, health, relationships, or about what should come next and where to head — and I guide you toward the answers. These are situations I know intimately. Not only from thirty years of practice alongside others, but also because I have lived through many of them myself.

teams.title: Executive Teams
teams.subtitle: For top leadership and key teams
teams.description: I help executive leadership and key teams function as a true team — particularly in periods when much more depends on their alignment than just immediate results. I know how top executive teams operate. And I know the paths to reach that level.

mediation.title: Mediation
mediation.subtitle: Disputes and conflicts where court is not the way
mediation.description: I help bring resolution to disputes and conflicts where court is not the way — it is costly, lacks discretion, and almost always ends with at least one party losing. As a mediator, I know that what ultimately decides an agreement is not law, but the ability to find what the parties share despite the conflict — and to build an acceptable solution on that foundation.

families.title: Family Governance
families.subtitle: Generational transitions and the future of the family
families.description: I help families establish family governance and prepare generational transitions in a way that strengthens rather than divides them. The path does not lead primarily through legal structures, but through the family's underlying values. I have thirty years of experience with Czech and international fiduciary structures — but the foundation is always work with the family itself.

about.title: About
about.body: I draw on thirty years of legal practice. I have led law firms — serving as Partner at Ambruz & Dark/PwC and as Managing Partner, Central Europe Leader and member of the global leadership of Deloitte Legal. Today I run my own legal practice and, alongside it, work as Executive Guide with a limited circle of clients. I have long been engaged in institutional life — as Chair of the Supervisory Board of Transparency International Czech Republic and a member of the Board of the Czech Bar Association. I am a certified coach (QED Group), mediator (Conflict Management International) and crisis intervention specialist (Remedium).

contact.title: Let's talk
contact.body: I work with a limited circle of clients to whom I can give the attention their situation deserves. Long-term and discreetly. We begin with a non-binding conversation — no expectations, no presentation. Just you and me, to find out whether we want to work together. I work in Czech and English.

hero.title: An agreement both sides can live with outlasts a verdict one side loses.
hero.subtitle: Independent guidance through difficult negotiations where court is not the way.

sections.heading: Disputes I work with
items: Corporate disputes between business partners
Disputes between shareholders over a company's direction or leadership
Family disputes with a financial dimension

sections.heading: Why not court
items: Litigation is costly — in money and in lost time
It isn't discreet — it becomes part of the public record
It almost always damages relationships you'll need to maintain afterward
It takes years, while an agreement can be reached in weeks

sections.heading: Approach
sections.body: Mediation is a structured process, not an informal meeting. I guide the parties to first name what they agree on despite the conflict, and we build a solution both sides can live with on that shared ground.

sections.heading: What mediation is not
sections.body: Mediation is not a softer version of court, and I am not an arbitrator. I don't take anyone's side and I don't issue a verdict. My role is to run the process so the parties reach an agreement themselves — one both genuinely intend to keep.

cta.title: Need to resolve a dispute?
cta.body: Tell me briefly what the dispute involves. We'll assess together whether mediation is the right path.
cta.label: Write to me

sections.heading: Approach
sections.body: I start with the family, not the structure. Legal and ownership arrangements only make sense once they reflect what the family actually agrees on — values, roles, and expectations. Without that agreement, even the best-drafted family constitution is just paper.
